title: India’s Operational Metro Rail Network Becomes World’s 3rd Largest

items: **Network Scale & Global Rank:** India’s operational metro rail network expanded to **1,095 km across 26 cities** in 2025 (up from 248 km across 5 cities in 2014), ranking as the **3rd-largest metro network in the world** (after China and the US).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → India metro network is 3rd largest globally (1,095 km across 26 cities).
